meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 代理就能把网页应用部署到 Vercel。技能会自动安装部署工具并配置登录凭据,代理可以直接执行生产部署、查看部署列表、检查登录状态。
howto.when: 当你要求代理把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。首次使用时需要你先提供 Vercel 个人访问令牌,技能会完成后续安装与配置。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 代理会运行 vercel deploy 发布到生产环境

say.text: 列出我在 Vercel 上最近的部署记录
say.note: 代理会运行 vercel ls 查看部署列表

say.text: 检查 Vercel 账号是否登录正常
say.note: 代理会运行 vercel whoami 验证认证

howto.what_en: Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and configures OneCLI to auto-inject Vercel credentials. Agents can then deploy web apps to Vercel and run deploy, list, and auth-check commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel. On first run it verifies prerequisites; if missing, it asks the user for a Vercel token and completes the setup.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel and publish to production
say_en.note: The agent runs vercel deploy to publish a production build

say_en.text: List my recent deployments on Vercel
say_en.note: The agent runs vercel ls to show the deployment list

say_en.text: Check if my Vercel account is authenticated
say_en.note: The agent runs vercel whoami to verify credentials
